headline: Supplementary budget sent to Senate committee
summary: The reformulated budget bill passed the Chamber of Deputies with 127 votes and was sent to the Senate Budget Committee. The committee will hold its first meeting on Monday to begin analysis of the bill.
why: A supplementary budget changes government spending and financing plans, which affects fiscal policy, sovereign debt expectations and the outlook for public investment.
original_headline: Presupuesto complementario es enviado a comisión del Senado
